references.context: Hit both upright targets beside Magneto to light a lock.
references.label: Magneto lock
references.description: The center lock assembly has two qualification targets, a captive lock ball, and the Magneto collect shot.

references.context: Shoot the Blackbird scoop and choose a Villain.
references.label: Blackbird scoop
references.description: The center-left scoop collects Mystery, starts Villains, and starts both wizard modes.

references.label: Iceman ramp
references.description: The right ramp starts and completes the short Iceman Hero mode.

references.context: Shoot Wolverine for the final Weapon X escape.
references.label: Wolverine bash toy
references.description: The center-right bash target starts and finishes Weapon X sequences and can activate its magnet.
